items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Gordon Parks told me at the screening ________, to him, Marshal Royal, he said, 'I got to have Marshal Royal.' ... [INTERVIEWEE] That was the second series of Shaft. That was the second one.

ctx.x: Most guys that had things played well by Basie just wrote things that they thought they would like to have played and then gave it to the Basie Band. We rehearsed it our way and played it our way and made it famous.
That's very interesting to know. I remember a film that I wanted to mention, because (inaudible)

few years ago, that was (inaudible), because Gordon Parks told me at the screening ________, to him, Marshal Royal, he said, "I told him 'I got to have Marshal Royal'." He said, "Doesn't that sound beautiful?" He said that when he -- I guess he wrote ________ lines for things and then (inaudible).
